mira: ran onboarding for llama-3x-8k (int8) against long-context suite. at ~6200 tokens the model output drifts and repeating fragments appear. kv-index diffs in the logs look like indexes colliding after a wrap. uploading logs: https://s3.redwood-ci/test-logs/1765501234/

ashok: can you paste a tiny reproducer here? was this with prefill or prefix priming?

mira: reproducer outline below, uses prefill then append-long. flags: `--prefill=fast --quant=int8-symmetric`
```python
# minimal flow
ctx = model.init_context(window=8192)
ctx.prefill(metadata_chunks * 50)  # ~5500 tokens
ctx.append(big_prompt)  # +1200 tokens
res = model.generate(ctx, max_tokens=64)
```
Logs show map entries like `KV[4094]` and then `KV[6]` getting overwritten with nearly identical POS leading to duplicate attention keys.

devon: what runtime? any recent changes to rotary/rope scaling?

mira: runtime `v2.3.1-candidate` + default rope_scale=1.0. i tried rope_scale=0.999 and 1.001, drift still reproducible.

sasha: can you run `scripts/longctx_smoketest.sh --window 8192 --offset 4096 --check-kv --dump-kv` and attach the `kv-dump.*.bin`? that helps see the positional slots.

ben: fwiw saw something like this last quarter with int4 when stride != tile_size. index collision at shard boundary. could be a tiling/stride mismatch in the cache map.

mira: snippet from kv dump (simplified):
```
KV_MAP[4094] = token_id: 34567, pos: 6198
KV_MAP[6]    = token_id: 34567, pos: 6204
# expected distinct keys; these align suspiciously
```

qa-bot: automated-matrix: longctx-suite v2.3.1-candidate -> FAIL (5/120 tests). failing rows: long-prepend-repeat, wrap-around-offset, rolling-prefill-append. added to regression dashboard: /dash/longctx/regressions/1765501234

ashok: assign to devon + sasha to produce minimal unit test and bisect runtime changes. devon you good to take?

devon: taking it. i'll reproduce locally and write a unit test around `kv_idx_for_token` and `kv_assign_slot`. i'll run the longctx tests with `--seed=42` to make diffs deterministic.

sasha: also try with `--rope-embedding-mode=phase-scaled` to see if phase handling changes alignment; if not, it's probably cache index arithmetic. i'll whip up a small harness that replays token stream and prints `(pos, shard, idx)` for each token.

mira: note: prompts used a repeated metadata block (~200 tokens) prepended many times. caching heuristics might evict/pin wrongly for repeated prefixes which could expose off-by-one in eviction wrap logic.

ben: short-term mitigation for customers: set `cache_window=4096` and `evict_threshold=0.8` on Dedicated pools to reduce likelihood of wrap in steady-state. not ideal but buys time.

devon: opening GH issue now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/4921 — attaching reproducer gist and initial dump. tagging @eng-infra @perf.

mira: uploaded aligned token diffs and sample output (diff highlight) to the issue. i'll also attach the full `kv-dump.*.bin`.

deploy-bot: smoke-deploy v2.3.1-candidate -> infra smoke ok for smallctx, longctx tests queued (ETA ~18m).

ashok: thanks everyone. devon/sasha, please update this thread with the failing unit test PR link and whether it's a runtime arithmetic bug or quant packing artifact.

devon: will do — first step: repro + unit test. ETA EOD PST. :hammer_and_wrench:

mira: thx. if you want the original long prompt i used i can paste redactable version here.

ben: :thumbsup:

qa-bot: note: adding test case to daily CI gating once PR lands.

mira: closing loop later with perf numbers and patched kv-map test outputs.
